verdict.rationale: Scale performance and item caps are a fair question for a task-tracking product like Trello, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents performance benchmarks, card or board limits, or behaviour in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. The only performance-adjacent item is a single anecdote about UI lag when creating a board, which says nothing about large-scale performance or caps.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
